svg.title: Continuous color: preserve order and define the reference
svg.desc: Synthetic example. Not paper results. Reproducible using the accompanying Python source.

g.text: Continuous color: preserve order and define the reference
Color rows encode identical 0–1 values; grayscale reveals their lightness order.
All values and palettes are synthetic. Sequential lightness is ordered; rainbow lightness rises then falls.
Grayscale is computed from linear-sRGB relative luminance; the diverging example has a defined zero.
